conditions: x is real, x!=-1 and x!=0; surd(x,3) is the real cube root, including for negative x.
An antiderivative is required on each of (-infinity,-1), (-1,0), and (0,infinity); additive constants may differ between these intervals.
ln(abs(...)) is the real logarithm of a positive argument.
x is real, including x=2; surd(x-2,5) is the real fifth root.
atan is the principal real inverse tangent.
A differentiable antiderivative is required on the entire real axis, up to one global additive constant.
